name: Procore
tagline: Construction management platform whose Drawings tool handles markup, revision tracking and links to RFIs and punch lists.
bestFor: General contractors and owners running many projects
description: Procore is a construction management platform. Its Drawings tool lets teams mark up sheets, compare revisions and link drawings to RFIs, punch lists and submittals; quantity takeoff is part of the separately sold Procore Estimating.
pros: Unlimited users and collaborators at no extra cost
Drawings link to RFIs, punch lists and submittals
Mobile drawing access works offline and syncs later
cons: No public prices; you need a sales quote
Annual fee is based on your annual construction volume
Quantity takeoff is part of the separate Estimating product

plans.name: Procore products (custom quote)
plans.notes: Quote only. Upfront annual fee per product, based on Annual Construction Volume. Unlimited users, data and storage; 24/7 support and training included.

name: PlanSwift
tagline: Windows takeoff and estimating software for measuring plans and pricing bids.
bestFor: Estimators doing takeoff on Windows PCs
description: PlanSwift is installed takeoff and estimating software for measuring and counting on plans and pricing jobs. Its Takeoff BOOST AI tools automate counting, scaling and bookmarking, and on the Core plan full takeoff.
pros: 14-day free trial with every feature and no card required
AI auto-count, auto-scale and auto-bookmark on every paid plan
cons: Runs only on 64-bit Windows; a Mac needs Boot Camp or a virtual machine
Annual billing only, with no monthly option listed
Auto Takeoff needs the more expensive Core plan
trial: 14-day free trial, all features, no credit card required

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Per seat, billed yearly at $2,000. Takeoff and estimating, Auto Count, Auto Scale and Auto Bookmark, 2 hours of live training.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Per seat, billed yearly at $3,000. Adds the full Takeoff BOOST suite with Auto Takeoff.

integrations: Excel import and export; send bids to other estimating systems

name: STACK
tagline: Cloud platform for construction takeoff, estimating, plan markup and field management.
bestFor: Subcontractors who want cloud takeoff with a free starting tier
description: STACK is cloud software for quantity takeoff and estimating, with plan overlay to find changes between drawing versions. Its Build & Operate product adds plan markup, punch lists, issues and daily reports, with field apps for iOS, Android and Windows.
pros: Free takeoff tier with no limit on users
Plan Overlay shows changes between drawing versions
Measures area, linear, arc, pitched, count and volume
cons: Monthly prices are not shown on the pricing pages
Free tier allows 1 active project a month and 50 measurements per project
Takeoff & Estimate plans cost $299 a user per month and up
freePlanDetails: 1 active project per month, up to 300 plan pages, 50 measurements per project, plan viewing and markup, core takeoff tools, unlimited users.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Per account, unlimited users. 1 active project per month, 300 plan pages, 50 measurements per project.

plans.name: Build & Operate Essential
plans.notes: Per user, billed annually. Unlimited projects and documents, document control, plan review and markup.

plans.name: Build & Operate Pro
plans.notes: Per user, billed annually. Adds daily reports, custom forms, configurable workflows and schedule tracking.

plans.name: Takeoff & Estimate Premium
plans.notes: Per user, billed annually. Unlimited projects, plan pages, measurements and viewer seats.

plans.name: Takeoff & Estimate Pro
plans.notes: Per user, billed annually. Adds worksheet-style estimating and STACK for Excel.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote only. Unlimited users, API, SSO and volume pricing.

integrations: STACK for Excel, ERP connectors (paid add-on)

name: Togal.AI
tagline: Cloud takeoff software that uses AI to detect, measure and count spaces and features on drawings.
bestFor: Estimators who want automated AI takeoff
description: Togal.AI is cloud takeoff software that automatically detects and measures spaces, counts items and compares drawing revisions to quantify what changed. Takeoffs export to Excel and other estimating tools, and several users can work on the same takeoff at once.
pros: Unlimited automated takeoffs on the Growth plan
Compares drawing revisions and quantifies added or removed items
Free external collaborators outside your account
cons: Billed yearly, with no monthly option listed
SSO and onboarding only on the custom-priced Business plan

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Per user, billed yearly. Unlimited automated takeoffs, chat prompts and symbol searches; unlimited external collaborators.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Custom price for 4 or more users. Adds onboarding, a dedicated support rep, quantity discounts and SSO.
